pages.title: Graviton Crystal
pages.text: Gravitons are the hypothetical quanta of gravity, and this crystal holds them frozen in a lattice. It feels heavier than it is: the stored gravitons pull on my hand as well as on the floor. Near it, falling dust curves slightly toward the crystal before reaching the ground.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I cooled Virtual Gravitons from the quantum foam in Superfluid Helium inside the Graviton Condenser until they could not escape. Graviton Wisps carry them naturally, and I found more in vaults, monoliths and derelict stations.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Graviton Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault, Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Brane Tether, Bulk Crystal, Bulk Stone, Compactification Lathe, Cosmic Processor, Cosmic String Lens, False Vacuum, Geodesic Anchor and more.
